title: Where Did the Repair First Go Wrong? Localizing the Origins of Silent Failures in Agentic Vulnerability Repair
title_zh: 评估最初在何处出错：定位智能体漏洞修复中静默故障的起源

paragraphs.en: Localizing where an LLM-based agent first fails to uphold security during a repair can show which stage of its workflow needs an additional safeguard. This is difficult for silent failures, which are patches that pass syntactic and functional checks but still contain a security vulnerability. Because such patches give no observable failure signal, existing failure attribution methods, which rely on observed task failures and labelled failure steps, are less suited to them. We propose Security Awareness Gap Evaluation (SAGE), a trace-based method that combines an assessment of the security reasoning recorded at each turn with the reconstructed code history to identify the earliest turn at which a repair diverges from the task’s security intent. We evaluate SAGE on 95 confirmed silent failures drawn from 3,684 repair traces produced by six agent frameworks and six base models on SecurityEval and CVEfixes. SAGE assigned an origin in 93 cases. Most origins were an unaddressed security requirement or an inadequate defence choice, and only five coincided with the code change itself. When the agent introduced the vulnerable code, the origin preceded the write in 14 of 19 cases. Repeated scoring and a second judge reproduced the origin type more consistently than the exact turn, and agreement was lowest for traces that kept only the final file.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly approach software repair as an iterative process of planning, tool use, code editing, and validation ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Yet, passing the available tests does not necessarily establish that the relevant security requirements have been met ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Recent work has identified silent failures (SFs): patches that pass the available syntactic and functional checks while retaining or introducing a security vulnerability ( Bai et al., 2026 ) . Confirming a silent failure shows that the delivered repair remains insecure, but not where the repair process first went wrong. The same insecure patch may stem from a plan that omits the relevant security requirement, a defence that does not close the weakness, or an implementation that applies an appropriate defence incorrectly. Such a flaw may then pass through later review stages unnoticed. Each origin may call for a different remedy, ranging from prompt refinement to an additional verification checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越倾向于将软件修复视为一个迭代过程，包括规划、工具使用、代码编辑和验证（Bouzenia 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2024）。 然而，通过现有测试并不必然意味着相关的安全要求已经得到满足（Zhao 等人，2026b）。 近期的研究识别出了一种“静默失败”（SF）：即补丁虽然通过了现有的语法和功能性检查，但却保留或引入了安全漏洞（Bai 等人，2026）。 确认存在静默失败表明所交付的修复仍然不安全，但无法确定修复过程最初出错的位置。 同一个不安全的补丁可能源于多种原因：例如计划中遗漏了相关的安全要求、防御措施未能消除漏洞，或者在实现过程中错误地应用了适当的防御手段。 此类缺陷随后可能在后续审查阶段未被察觉地通过。 每种成因可能需要不同的解决方案，从优化提示词到增加额外的验证检查点不等。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask where in the execution trace a divergence from the task’s security intent first becomes observable. We define this position as the origin of the silent failure: the earliest turn at which the recorded reasoning or artefact history shows such a divergence, as opposed to the write that eventually places the vulnerable code in the file. Figure 1 illustrates two ways in which the origin of a silent failure can differ from a code change. In case (a), the planner agent selects AES in ECB mode at turn 1, two turns before the vulnerable code is written. A diff identifies the introducing write, but only the trace reveals the earlier inadequate defence choice. In case (b), the vulnerable code is inherited from the input file and remains untouched, so there is no introducing write to locate. The trace instead records an initial plan that omits the relevant security requirement and a subsequent review that does not revisit the omitted requirement. Final-patch analysis alone is therefore insufficient; origin localization calls for examining the recorded repair reasoning alongside the artefact history, and for separating the origin from both the introducing write and later missed detection opportunities.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们想知道在执行追踪中，与任务安全意图的偏离最早在哪个环节变得可观察。 我们将这一位置定义为静默故障的起点：即记录在案的推理或产物历史最早出现此类偏离的回合，而非最终将易受攻击代码写入文件的操作。 图 1 展示了静默故障的起点可能与代码变更存在差异的两种情况。 在情况 (a) 中，规划智能体在第 1 个回合选择了 ECB 模式的 AES，此时距离易受攻击代码被写入还有两个回合。 差异分析可以识别出引入该问题的写入操作，但只有执行追踪能揭示更早的不充分防御选择。 在情况 (b) 中，易受攻击的代码是从输入文件中继承而来的且未被修改，因此没有可定位的引入性写入操作。 相反，执行追踪记录了一个最初遗漏了相关安全要求的计划，以及后续一次并未重新审视该被遗漏要求的审查过程。 因此，仅依赖最终补丁分析是不够的；要确定故障起点，必须同时检查记录在案的修复推理和产物历史，并将该起点与引入性写入操作及之后未能检测到的机会区分开来。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we propose Security Awareness Gap Evaluation (SAGE), a trace-based method for localizing the origin of a silent failure. SAGE first normalizes framework-specific traces into a common sequence of turns. It then uses an LLM judge, given only the trace prefix available at each turn, to score the security reasoning expressed along four dimensions; every non-zero score must cite a verbatim quotation linked to the raw record (see Section 3.3.1 ). In parallel, it reconstructs the artefact history to determine when the vulnerable code was introduced or left in place. Finally, an explicit decision rule combines the scores and artefact history with the confirmed failure anchor to identify the earliest trace-attributable divergence from the task’s security intent (see Section 3.3.2 ). We evaluate the resulting origin assignments through repeated scoring, cross-judge comparison, task-disjoint subsets, and human annotation of artefact-derived outputs. Three research questions (RQs) guide the study:
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一差距，我们提出了安全意识差距评估（SAGE），这是一种基于轨迹的方法，用于定位静默故障的根源。 SAGE 首先将特定框架的轨迹归一化为一个通用的回合序列。 接着，它使用一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判，仅根据每个回合可用的轨迹前缀，对沿四个维度表达的安全推理进行评分；每个非零分数都必须引用与原始记录直接关联的逐字引文（参见第 3.3.1 节）。 同时，它重构产物历史，以确定脆弱代码是何时引入或未被移除的。 最后，一个明确的决策规则将评分和产物历史与已确认的故障锚点相结合，以识别最早可归因于轨迹的、偏离任务安全意图的分歧（参见第 3.3.2 节）。 我们通过重复评分、跨裁判比较、任务无关的子集划分以及对源自产物的输出进行人工标注，来评估最终确定的根源分配结果。 三项研究问题（RQs）指导了本研究：

paragraphs.zh: 静默故障源自何处？又有哪些痕迹证据支持了这些被认定的来源？

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SAGE on 95 confirmed silent failures identified among 3,684 valid repair traces generated by six open-source agent frameworks and six base models on tasks from SecurityEval ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ) and CVEfixes ( Bhandari et al., 2021 ) . SAGE localizes an origin in 97.89% of cases (93/95). Most identified origins involve unaddressed security requirements or inadequate defence choices. Among the 19 cases in which the agent introduced vulnerable code, the origin precedes the introducing write in 14. Repeated scoring and an independent judge model reproduce the same origin type in most cases. Agreement with human annotators on code provenance and the introducing write is moderate to substantial ( κ \kappa between 0.58 and 0.74) and varies across task subsets. Exact-turn agreement is lowest for the small group of traces that preserve only the final file.

paragraphs.en: Security of LLM-generated code and agentic vulnerability repair. Empirical studies report security weaknesses in LLM-generated code ( Pearce et al., 2022 ; Asare et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2025 ; Majdinasab et al., 2024 ; Perry et al., 2023 ) and limitations in LLM vulnerability detection and reasoning ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Ullah et al., 2024 ) . Datasets such as SecurityEval, LLMSecEval, CVEfixes, and BaxBench support security evaluation through vulnerability prompts, historical fixes, and exploit-based tests ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ; Tony et al., 2023 ; Bhandari et al., 2021 ; Vero et al., 2025 ) . Zero-shot and neural repair approaches remain limited on real-world vulnerabilities ( Pearce et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , and attention has moved to agents that locate, edit, and validate fixes over several turns ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Such runs are commonly scored by test passage ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , yet test-passing patches may still be incorrect ( Smith et al., 2015 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and a simple non-agentic pipeline can achieve competitive scores ( Xia et al., 2025 ) . These studies motivate evaluation beyond final test outcomes, but they do not explain where in an agentic repair trajectory a security failure first becomes attributable.
paragraphs.zh: LLM生成代码的安全性与智能体漏洞修复。 实证研究指出，LLM生成的代码存在安全弱点（Pearce等，2022；Asare等，2023；Fu等，2025；Majdinasab等，2024；Perry等，2023），且LLM在漏洞检测与推理方面也存在局限性（Ding等，2025；Ullah等，2024）。 SecurityEval、LLMSecEval、CVEfixes和BaxBench等数据集通过漏洞提示、历史修复方案及基于攻击利用的测试，支持安全评估（Siddiq和Santos，2022；Tony等，2023；Bhandari等，2021；Vero等，2025）。 零样本与神经修复方法在应对真实世界漏洞时仍存在局限（Pearce等，2023；Wu等，2023），研究重点已转向能够多轮定位、编辑并验证修复方案的智能体（Bouzenia等，2025；Zhang等，2024）。 此类运行通常通过测试用例进行评分（Jimenez等，2024），但通过测试的补丁可能仍存在错误（Smith等，2015；Wang等，2026；Zhou等，2024），且一个简单的非智能体流程也能取得具有竞争力的分数（Xia等，2025）。 这些研究推动了超越最终测试结果的评价需求，但并未说明在智能体修复流程的哪个阶段，安全失败首次可归因于该流程本身。

paragraphs.en: Silent failures in agentic repair. Bai et al. ( Bai et al., 2026 ) studied silent failures in agentic vulnerability repair and classified confirmed SF cases by category, agent role, and workflow stage. That work shows that security deficiencies can remain hidden behind patches that pass available syntactic and functional checks. The present study addresses the next diagnostic problem: once a silent failure is confirmed, where in the recorded repair trajectory did the process first diverge from the task’s security intent? This requires separating the origin turn from code provenance, the introducing write, and later missed detection opportunities. Prior silent-failure categorization did not provide a systematic method for such turn-level localization or evaluate whether origin assignments are consistent across scoring runs and judges.

paragraphs.en: Failure analysis and attribution in agentic systems. Taxonomies characterize agent failures by system design, inter-agent misalignment, and task verification ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) , and analyses of repair-agent trajectories associate failed runs with repetitive, non-adaptive action cycles ( Bouzenia and Pradel, 2025 ) . AgentDebug classifies errors by agent module and diagnoses root-cause errors to guide recovery ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Attribution methods identify responsible agents or steps under different evidence conditions. Zhang et al. ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) apply LLM-based attribution to failed multi-agent runs where task failure is observable and step-level labels are available. AgenTracer ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) trains a tracer on failure trajectories constructed through counterfactual replay and fault injection. FAMAS ( Ge et al., 2026 ) ranks agents and actions using spectrum analysis over repeated executions, requiring additional trajectories that may be unavailable in a single-trace audit. DuoTrace ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) learns regular execution patterns from normal trajectories and filters anomalous steps before downstream attribution, but its anomaly scores are not designed to link a step to a confirmed security deficiency in a functionally passing patch. Benchmark studies further show that attribution accuracy depends on the completeness of the supplied evidence ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and remains limited on lengthy traces ( Deshpande et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, SAGE localizes within a single trace whose functional checks passed and asks where the security-intent divergence first becomes trace-attributable.

paragraphs.en: LLM-as-a-judge in software engineering. LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate generated code and software agents ( Tong and Zhang, 2024 ; Zhuge et al., 2025 ) . However, their agreement with human evaluators varies across tasks ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and their verdicts can shift with prompt formulation and answer position ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . These findings are directly relevant to SAGE because origin localization uses judge-assigned assessments of expressed security reasoning. Therefore, we do not rely on a single LLM judgment as ground truth. Instead, SAGE uses prefix-only, quotation-anchored scoring and evaluates reliability through repeated scoring, cross-judge comparison, task-disjoint resampling, and human annotation of artefact-derived outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程中作为评判者的 LLM。 LLM 评判者正被越来越多地用于评估生成的代码和软件智能体（Tong 和 Zhang，2024；Zhuge 等，2025）。 然而，它们与人类评估者的一致性因任务而异（Wang 等，2025a），且其评判结果可能随着提示的构建方式和答案的位置而改变（Zhao 等，2026a）。 这些发现与 SAGE 直接相关，因为来源定位依赖于评判者对已表达的安全推理所赋予的评估。 因此，我们不依赖单个 LLM 的判断作为基准事实。 相反，SAGE 使用仅基于前缀、以引文为锚点的评分机制，并通过重复评分、跨评判者比较、任务无关的重采样以及对源自成果的输出进行人工标注来评估可靠性。

sents.zh: 这些发现与 SAGE 直接相关，因为来源定位依赖于评判者对已表达的安全推理所赋予的评估。

sents.en: Therefore, we do not rely on a single LLM judgment as ground truth.
sents.zh: 因此，我们不依赖单个 LLM 的判断作为基准事实。

sents.en: Instead, SAGE uses prefix-only, quotation-anchored scoring and evaluates reliability through repeated scoring, cross-judge comparison, task-disjoint resampling, and human annotation of artefact-derived outputs.
sents.zh: 相反，SAGE 使用仅基于前缀、以引文为锚点的评分机制，并通过重复评分、跨评判者比较、任务无关的重采样以及对源自成果的输出进行人工标注来评估可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Positioning of this study. Relative to the closest work, SAGE combines three features for localizing confirmed silent failures. First, it analyses a single recorded repair whose patch passed available syntactic and functional checks but was independently confirmed to contain a security deficiency. Second, it combines the failure anchor, prefix-only assessment of expressed security reasoning, and reconstructed artefact history to identify the earliest trace-attributable divergence under a systematic localization rule. This separates the origin turn from code provenance and, where one exists, the introducing write; it also allows origins to be assigned for inherited vulnerabilities. Third, it evaluates reliability from complementary sources: repeated scoring and cross-judge comparison for origin type and origin turn, and human annotation plus task-disjoint resampling for artefact-derived outputs. In this way, the study moves beyond asking whether an agentic repair succeeded or failed, and instead examines where a confirmed security failure first becomes observable in the repair process.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的位置。 与最接近的研究相比，SAGE 结合了三种特征来定位已确认的静默故障。 首先，它分析单个已记录的修复操作，其补丁通过了可用的句法和功能检查，但经独立确认存在安全缺陷。 其次，它结合故障锚点、仅基于前缀的安全推理表达评估以及重构的产物历史，依据系统化的定位规则识别最早可追溯至特定痕迹的分歧点。 这使起源轮次与代码来源区分开来，并在存在引入操作时将其分离；同时也能对继承的漏洞分配起源。 第三，它从互补的来源评估可靠性：通过重复评分和跨评审员比较来评估起源类型和起源轮次，并通过人工标注以及任务无关的重采样来评估源自产物的输出。 通过这种方式，本研究超越了“智能体修复是否成功或失败”的问题，转而考察已确认的安全故障在修复过程中最早在哪个环节变得可观察。

paragraphs.en: We use two publicly available security-focused datasets: SecurityEval ( Siddiq and Santos, 2022 ) and CVEfixes ( Bhandari et al., 2021 ) . Tasks were selected according to four criteria: security relevance, availability of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) annotations, Python implementation, and compatibility with the selected agent frameworks. After language and format filtering, the two datasets provide a pool of 1,236 eligible tasks: 121 from SecurityEval and 1,115 from CVEfixes. From this pool, we draw 150 tasks (75 per dataset), using a fixed random seed and stratification by CWE family with proportional allocation within each dataset. Each SecurityEval task supplies the code context of its prompt as the input file, and each CVEfixes task supplies the vulnerable version of the file together with a repair instruction naming the target CVE and CWE.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了两个公开可用的安全导向数据集：SecurityEval（Siddiq 和 Santos，2022）以及 CVEfixes（Bhandari 等人，2021）。 任务的选取依据四个标准：安全性相关性、通用弱点枚举（CWE）标注的可用性、Python 实现情况，以及与所选智能体框架的兼容性。 经过语言和格式筛选后，这两个数据集共提供了 1,236 个符合条件的任务：其中 SecurityEval 提供 121 个，CVEfixes 提供 1,115 个。 我们从这个任务池中抽取了 150 个任务（每个数据集各 75 个），过程中使用了固定的随机种子，并按 CWE 家族进行分层，同时在每个数据集中采用比例分配方法。 每个 SecurityEval 任务都将提示中的代码上下文作为输入文件提供；而每个 CVEfixes 任务则提供该文件的脆弱版本，并附带一个修复指令，其中指明了目标 CVE 和 CWE。

paragraphs.en: We select six open-source frameworks that had active release lines at the time of corpus construction and were applicable to vulnerability repair, directly or through adaptation (see Table 1 ). Each framework is executed with six base models: GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , Kimi K3 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.8-Max ( Alibaba Group, 2026 ) . These models were selected for coding and reasoning capability, programmatic access, and compatibility with the frameworks’ context-length and tool-use requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了六个在语料库构建时具有活跃发布线且适用于漏洞修复（无论是直接适用，还是经过适配后适用）的开源框架（参见表 1）。 每个框架均使用六个基础模型执行：GPT-5.5（OpenAI, 2026a）、Claude Opus 4.8（Anthropic, 2026a）、Gemini 3.1 Pro（Google DeepMind, 2026）、DeepSeek-V4-Pro（DeepSeek-AI, 2026）、Kimi K3（Moonshot AI, 2026）以及 Qwen3.8-Max（Alibaba Group, 2026）。 这些模型因其编码与推理能力、程序化访问权限，以及与各框架的上下文长度和工具使用要求相兼容而被选中。

paragraphs.en: To limit variation arising from execution settings, all frameworks and models use the same generation parameters where supported (temperature 1.0, 600-second timeout), and each run executes in an isolated environment allocated 5 CPU cores, 16 GB of RAM, and 512 GB of storage. Task content is kept unchanged across frameworks; only its format is adapted to each framework’s input interface.
paragraphs.zh: 为限制执行设置引起的差异，所有框架和模型在支持的情况下均使用相同的生成参数（温度 1.0，600 秒超时），且每次运行都在分配了 5 个 CPU 核心、16 GB RAM 和 512 GB 存储的独立环境中执行。 任务内容在各框架中保持不变；仅将其格式适配到各框架的输入接口。

paragraphs.en: Each task is executed once with each of the 36 framework–model configurations (5,400 runs), and each execution produces a generated patch, a complete agent trace, and any intermediate or auxiliary artefacts created during the repair process. Runs that terminate without producing a valid modification, including crashes, timeouts, and incomplete generations, are recorded as invalid traces and excluded. After this exclusion, 3,684 traces (68.22%) enter verification, of which 331 are flagged as silent failure candidates; Table 2 reports these counts and the excluded runs by framework.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都会针对 36 种框架-模型配置（共 5,400 次运行）各执行一次，每次执行都会生成一个生成的补丁、一个完整的智能体轨迹，以及修复过程中产生的任何中间或辅助产物。 那些未产生有效修改而终止的运行（包括崩溃、超时和生成不完整的情况）会被记录为无效轨迹并排除在外。 经过这一排除步骤后，有 3,684 条轨迹（占 68.22%）进入验证阶段，其中 331 条被标记为静默失败候选；表 2 报告了这些数量以及按框架分类的排除运行次数。

paragraphs.en: Generated patches are evaluated using a multi-level verification framework ( Bai et al., 2026 ) :
paragraphs.zh: 生成的补丁通过一个多级验证框架进行评估（Bai 等人，2026）：

paragraphs.en: Level 0 (L0): Syntactic validity. The generated code can be parsed without syntax errors.
paragraphs.zh: 第 0 级（L0）：句法有效性。 生成的代码可以解析且没有句法错误。

sents.en: Level 0 (L0): Syntactic validity.
sents.zh: 第 0 级（L0）：句法有效性。

sents.en: The generated code can be parsed without syntax errors.
sents.zh: 生成的代码可以解析且没有句法错误。

paragraphs.en: Level 1 (L1): Functional validation. The generated artefact passes the available functional checks: its imports resolve, the functions and classes defined in the input file are preserved, and the associated tests pass where the task provides them. As SecurityEval provides no test suites, its tasks are assessed with the first two checks.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 级 (L1)：功能验证。 生成的产物通过所有可用的功能检查：其导入项可正确解析，输入文件中定义的功能和类得以保留，并且在任务提供了相关测试时，这些测试也能通过。 由于 SecurityEval 未提供测试套件，其任务仅通过前两项检查进行评估。

sents.en: Level 1 (L1): Functional validation.
sents.zh: 第 1 级 (L1)：功能验证。

sents.en: The generated artefact passes the available functional checks: its imports resolve, the functions and classes defined in the input file are preserved, and the associated tests pass where the task provides them.

paragraphs.en: Level 2 (L2): Static security analysis. Bandit analyses the generated artefacts, with findings mapped to CWE identifiers. Patches containing high-severity findings are flagged.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 级（L2）：静态安全分析。 Bandit 会分析生成的产物，并将发现结果映射到 CWE 标识符。 包含高严重性发现的补丁会被标记出来。

sents.en: Level 2 (L2): Static security analysis.
sents.zh: 第 2 级（L2）：静态安全分析。

sents.en: Bandit analyses the generated artefacts, with findings mapped to CWE identifiers.
sents.zh: Bandit 会分析生成的产物，并将发现结果映射到 CWE 标识符。

sents.en: Patches containing high-severity findings are flagged.
sents.zh: 包含高严重性发现的补丁会被标记出来。

paragraphs.en: Level 3 (L3): Exploitability-oriented screening. A rule-based score R ∈ [ 0,100 ] R\in[0,100] is computed for each patch by pattern matching. It sums weights for attacker-controllable input sources (2–4) and dangerous sinks such as dynamic code execution or unsafe deserialization (6–12); a sink weight is multiplied by 1.5 when a source occurs in the same patch and by 1.3 when the sink matches the CWE targeted by the task. The score increases by 10 if the targeted weakness pattern persists and decreases by 2 for each detected safeguard category (at most 10). A patch is flagged when R ≥ 15 R\geq 15 , using the maximum file score for multi-file patches. These settings follow prior work ( Bai et al., 2026 ) ; because every flagged candidate is reviewed manually, the threshold sets screening sensitivity.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 级（L3）：以可利用性为导向的筛选。 通过模式匹配，为每个补丁计算一个基于规则的分值 R ∈ [0,100]。 该分值累加攻击者可控制的输入源（2–4）以及危险汇点（如动态代码执行或不安全的反序列化，6–12）的权重；若同一补丁中存在对应的输入源，则汇点权重乘以 1.5；若该汇点与任务所针对的 CWE 匹配，则乘以 1.3。 如果所针对的弱点模式持续存在，分值增加 10；每检测到一个防护类别，分值减少 2（最多减少 10）。 当 R ≥ 15 时，该补丁会被标记；对于包含多个文件的补丁，使用最高的文件分值进行判断。 这些设置遵循先前的研究（Bai 等人，2026）；由于每个被标记的候选项都会经过人工审查，因此阈值决定了筛选的灵敏度。

paragraphs.en: Patches that pass L0 and L1 but are flagged at L2 or L3 are treated as silent failure candidates. CAMEL accounts for 292 of the 509 L0/L1 failures, of which 241 failed functional validation (L1), mostly because the delivered file omitted functions or classes defined in the input file. These levels provide screening signals. Only manually confirmed candidates are included in the corpus.

paragraphs.en: True positive (TP) : the patch retains or introduces a clear vulnerability relevant to the task;

paragraphs.en: Both TP and Partial cases are retained in the confirmed silent failure corpus, whereas FP cases are excluded. To assess the consistency of this confirmation process and limit potential individual bias, we conduct an Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) analysis. The first annotator (R1) reviews all silent failure candidates, while a second annotator (R2) independently reviews a random subset of 60 candidates using the same criteria. Agreement is assessed primarily using Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) , with percent agreement and Gwet’s AC 1 ( Gwet, 2008 ) reported as complementary measures in Table 3 . As inclusion in the corpus is a binary decision (TP or Partial versus FP), we also report binary agreement: the annotators agreed on 54 of the 60 candidates (90.00%; κ = 0.74 \kappa=0.74 ). All disagreements were resolved through discussion between the two annotators. The resulting corpus contains 95 confirmed silent failure cases from 19 tasks (87 cases from 15 CVEfixes tasks and 8 from 4 SecurityEval tasks), each with a failure anchor recording the affected artefact and the confirmed deficiency (an absent defence, an insufficient defence, or a vulnerability introduced by the change). The largest task, a CVEfixes repair of a server-side request forgery vulnerability, contributes 16 cases.

paragraphs.en: The selected frameworks record messages, tool calls, and artefact changes in different formats and at different levels of granularity. To enable consistent analysis across frameworks, we normalize each execution trace into a sequence of canonical turns.

paragraphs.en: A canonical turn consists of an agent-authored message together with the tool calls, tool results, and artefact changes associated with that message. paragraphs.en: In Phase II, SAGE operates on the canonical turns produced by trace normalization. It first measures the security reasoning expressed in every turn and then locates two positions for each confirmed silent failure: the introducing write, derived from the artefact history alone, and the origin turn, derived from the artefact history together with the per-turn scores.

paragraphs.en: Alongside these dimensions, each turn is assigned two auxiliary labels: (i) Applicability , which distinguishes substantive planning, implementation, review, and verification turns from administrative framework events, such as environment setup or tool polling; and (ii) Security opportunity , which indicates whether the turn makes or reviews a decision, code path, or artefact materially connected to the task’s security intent, so that security reasoning at that turn could affect whether this intent is met. The judge assigns this label from the task context and the trace prefix only, without access to the confirmed deficiency; the origin rule links candidate turns to the deficiency afterwards (see Section 3.3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些维度之外，每个回合还被分配了两个辅助标签：(i) 适用性（Applicability），用于区分实质性规划、实施、审查和验证回合与行政框架事件（如环境设置或工具轮询）；以及 (ii) 安全机会（Security opportunity），用于指示该回合是否做出或审查了与任务安全目标有实质性关联的决定、代码路径或产物，从而使得该回合的安全推理可能影响这一目标能否实现。 裁判仅根据任务上下文和追踪前缀来分配此标签，而无法访问已确认的缺陷；原始规则会在之后将候选回合与缺陷关联起来（参见第 3.3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ) as the primary LLM judge because it lies outside the evaluated base-model set, so that no trace is scored by the model that produced it. The judge scores one canonical turn (see Section 3.2.6 ) at a time in trace order, receiving the task context and the trace up to and including that turn; later turns, multi-level verification results, and confirmation labels are withheld. To ensure auditability, every non-zero score must include a verbatim quotation linked to a canonical item and, through it, to the raw execution trace. All turns involving code planning, implementation, review, or verification are scored. An applicable turn with no expressed security reasoning receives a score of 0, indicating the absence of such reasoning in the recorded trace. Only administrative framework events, such as formatting, file bookkeeping, and framework handshake messages, are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 GPT-5.6 Sol（OpenAI，2026b）用作主要的大型语言模型评判者，因为它不在所评估的基础模型集合中，因此生成它的模型不会对其产生的痕迹进行评分。 该评判者每次按顺序对一条痕迹中的一个标准回合（参见第 3.2.6 节）进行评分，接收任务上下文以及包含该回合在内的痕迹；后续回合、多级验证结果和确认标签则不予提供。 为确保可审计性，每个非零分数都必须包含与某个标准条目相关联的逐字引文，并通过该条目关联到原始执行痕迹。 所有涉及代码规划、实现、审查或验证的回合均会被评分。 一个适用但未明确表达安全推理的回合将获得 0 分，表示记录在案的痕迹中不存在此类推理。 仅排除管理框架事件，例如格式设置、文件簿记和框架握手消息。

paragraphs.en: After scoring, SAGE localizes each confirmed silent failure using the failure anchor recorded during manual confirmation, the reconstructed artefact history, and the per-turn scores. The anchor identifies the confirmed deficiency and the affected artefact, but contains no origin label. The origin turn is the earliest canonical turn at which the available evidence indicates a failure to satisfy the task’s security intent and links that failure to the confirmed deficiency under the rule below. This operational definition identifies a trace-attributable divergence. Supporting evidence may come from expressed reasoning or artefact changes; an introducing write is therefore not required to localize the origin of an inherited vulnerability.

paragraphs.en: Localization proceeds in two steps. The first step establishes code provenance. The original vulnerable artefact is treated as the baseline and compared with the snapshot produced after each write. A deficiency is classified as agent-introduced when its anchor-linked fragment is absent from the baseline and appears in a later snapshot. This category includes newly introduced weaknesses, insufficient mitigations, and the removal or weakening of an existing defence. A deficiency is classified as inherited from the input file when it already exists in the original code and is not eliminated by subsequent writes.

paragraphs.en: All localization results are checked automatically. For an agent-introduced deficiency, the check verifies that the anchor-linked fragment is absent from the baseline, is introduced or reintroduced by the selected write, and remains present thereafter. For a deficiency inherited from the input file, the check verifies that the anchored deficiency is present in the baseline and persists across subsequent snapshots. These checks ensure the fragment history aligns with the assigned provenance and that the origin turn precedes or coincides with the introducing write. Fragment matching only locates code; the vulnerability itself is established through manual confirmation (see Section 3.2.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有定位结果都会经过自动检查。 对于由智能体引入的缺失，该检查会验证锚点关联片段在基线中不存在、被选中的写入操作引入或重新引入，并在之后持续存在。 对于从输入文件中继承的缺失，该检查会验证锚定缺失存在于基线中，并在后续快照中持续存在。 这些检查确保片段历史与指定的来源一致，且起源回合早于或与被引入的写入操作同时发生。 片段匹配仅能定位代码；漏洞本身需通过人工确认确定（参见第 3.2.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: In Phase III, we assess SAGE through a multi-source reliability evaluation (see Figure 3 ): repeated scoring and cross-judge comparison assess the consistency of judge-dependent outputs, while human annotation and task-disjoint resampling assess agreement on artefact-derived outputs and its sensitivity to task composition.
paragraphs.zh: 在第三阶段，我们通过多源可靠性评估来检验 SAGE（参见图 3）：重复评分和跨评判者比较用于评估依赖评判者的输出结果的一致性，而人工标注和任务无关的重采样则用于评估基于人工制品的输出结果的一致性及其对任务构成的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the reliability and robustness of SAGE through three complementary analyses:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过三种相互补充的分析方法来评估 SAGE 的可靠性和鲁棒性：

paragraphs.en: Scoring stability. The primary LLM judge (GPT-5.6 Sol) scores the full set of confirmed silent failures once. A stratified random subset (60 of the 95 SF cases, across all frameworks) is scored in two additional runs, giving three scores per case in the subset. The subset covers different frameworks and reconstruction conditions. Across the three runs, we evaluate consistency on the four dimension scores at the origin turn and on the origin type and origin turn re-derived from each run’s scores.
paragraphs.zh: 评分稳定性。主要 LLM 评判者（GPT-5.6 Sol）对全部已确认的静默失败案例进行一次评分。随后，从这 95 个静默失败案例中分层随机抽取一个子集（共 60 个，涵盖所有框架），进行两次额外评分，使得该子集中的每个案例获得三个评分。该子集覆盖了不同的框架和重建条件。在三次评分中，我们评估了四个维度评分在原始回合上的一致性，以及根据每次评分重新推导出的原始类型和原始回合的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Cross-judge consistency. A second LLM judge (Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) ) independently scores the same subset using the same rubric, prompt, and prefix-only context. This judge is blind to the primary scores, human annotations, and localization results. We compare the two judges on the same measures.
paragraphs.zh: 跨智能体一致性。 第二个 LLM 智能体（Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic, 2026b)）使用相同的评分标准、提示词和仅包含前缀的上下文，独立地对同一子集进行评分。 该智能体无法看到主评分、人类标注结果以及本地化结果。 我们在相同的评估指标上对这两个智能体进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Robustness across data subsets. To assess whether SAGE–human agreement depends on the composition of the evaluation set, we conduct two task-level resampling analyses on the 95 confirmed SF cases. First, across 1,000 random partitions, tasks are divided into two approximately equal, task-disjoint subsets, keeping all cases from the same task within the same subset. Agreement is recomputed separately for each resulting subset using the same metrics. Second, a leave-one-task-out analysis recomputes agreement after iteratively excluding each task.
paragraphs.zh: 跨数据子集的稳健性。 为了评估 SAGE 与人类的共识是否依赖于评估集的成分，我们对 95 例已确认的 SF 病例进行了两项任务层面的重采样分析。 首先，在 1,000 次随机划分中，任务被分为两个大致相等且互不重叠的任务子集，同时确保同一任务的所有病例都保留在同一个子集中。 对于每个生成的子集，使用相同的指标分别重新计算共识度。 其次，通过逐次排除每个任务，再计算共识度，从而进行“留一任务”分析。

paragraphs.en: We compare SAGE’s code provenance and introducing-write labels with human annotation; the origin type and origin turn are not annotated by humans and are assessed for consistency only (see Section 3.4.1 ). The first annotator (R1) labels all 95 confirmed cases, and a second annotator (R2) independently labels a stratified subset of 60 cases. Neither annotator is shown the SAGE scores or automated localization outputs. Both use the same failure anchors and reconstructed artefact histories as SAGE to label code provenance and the introducing write (a specific write turn, no introducing write, or cannot determine). Because R1 participated in corpus construction and in the design of the localization rule, R1 may be familiar with the cases and with the rule’s logic; R2 was not involved in either step.

paragraphs.en: Artefact histories establish code provenance. SAGE classified 73 cases as inherited from the input file (76.84%) and 19 as agent-introduced (20.00%); three cases could not be linked to an identifiable code location (3.16%; see Table 5 (a)). These outputs describe the available code-history evidence, while localization of the origin additionally draws on the trace record. For example, in one case, the agent completed the requested repair but introduced an unsafe configuration absent from the input file. The artefact change provides evidence for an introducing write, while identifying any earlier origin requires examining the preceding reasoning. In another case, a vulnerable database operation remained unchanged from the input file to the final patch. Its history supports inherited provenance but provides no introducing write, so origin candidates must be sought in the reasoning record.
paragraphs.zh: 产物历史确立了代码的来源。 SAGE 将 73 个案例归类为从输入文件中继承而来（76.84%），19 个案例归类为智能体引入的（20.00%）；有 3 个案例无法关联到可识别的代码位置（3.16%；参见表 5(a)）。 这些输出描述了现有的代码历史证据，而对起源的定位还进一步依赖了追踪记录。 例如，在一个案例中，智能体完成了所请求的修复，但引入了一种输入文件中不存在的不安全配置。 产物的变更提供了引入性写入的证据，但要确定任何更早的起源，则需要检查此前的推理过程。 在另一个案例中，一个存在漏洞的数据库操作从输入文件到最终补丁始终保持未变。 其历史支持了继承来源的说法，但并未提供任何引入性写入的证据，因此必须在推理记录中寻找可能的起源。

paragraphs.en: Beyond code changes, the agents’ repair plans and explanations reveal how vulnerabilities persisted or emerged. Because the rule restricts origin candidates to the introducing write or earlier turns, this temporal ordering holds by construction. SAGE also assigned an origin turn in nearly all cases without an identifiable introducing write (74/76, 97.37%). These cases comprise vulnerabilities inherited from the input file and cases for which no specific code location could be identified.

paragraphs.en: SAGE flagged missed detection opportunities in 59 cases. SAGE records a post-origin implementation or review turn as a missed detection opportunity when its verification-rigour or scope-awareness score is at most 1 (see Section 3.3.2 ). At least one such opportunity was identified in the majority of cases (59/95, 62.11%) (see Table 5 (d)). The flags were concentrated in frameworks with multi-turn traces (AG2 29/32, Deep Agents 13/13, MiniSWE-Agent 11/15, OpenHands 4/9, CAMEL 2/4), whereas none of the 22 Aider cases was flagged because their single-message traces contain no turn after the origin. The overall share therefore largely reflects the framework composition of the corpus. Even in AG2, whose group chat includes a dedicated security reviewer, 28 of the 32 cases had a flagged reviewer turn. These flags reflect low recorded verification rigour or scope awareness under the SAGE rule. For example, in one case, the reviewer agent endorsed the completed sorting repair and reported no remaining issues, although an unsafe code-access configuration remained. SAGE left two of the 95 cases undetermined (2.11%; see Figure 4 (a)): one with a vulnerability inherited from the input file and one without an identifiable code location. In both, no candidate turn could be linked to the confirmed deficiency. For the other two cases without an identifiable code location, SAGE assigned an origin from the planning and dialogue records alone, in both cases as an unaddressed security requirement.

paragraphs.en: Repeated scoring suggests that SAGE reproduces the type of the recorded divergence more consistently than its exact turn. Table 6 (a) shows that the primary judge assigned an origin in all three runs for most cases (57/60, 95.00%). Within this shared set, agreement was higher for origin type (55/57, 96.49%) than for the exact origin turn (50/57, 87.72%), suggesting that the nature of the recorded divergence was more consistently reproduced than its precise position. Allowing a one-turn difference increased agreement to 91.23% (52/57), covering two additional cases whose assigned origins fell on neighbouring turns. Krippendorff’s α \alpha followed the same pattern, reaching 0.96 for origin type and 0.82 for origin turn. Figure 5 (a) complements these results by showing consistent scoring across all four SAGE dimensions, with ordinal α \alpha ranging from 0.89 to 0.95. Ordinal α \alpha between the two judges was nevertheless lower than within the primary judge: 0.76 for threat recognition, 0.86 for defensive intent, and 0.68 for both verification rigour and scope awareness. The latter two dimensions also determine which turns are flagged as missed detection opportunities, so these flags may likewise be sensitive to the choice of judge.

paragraphs.en: SAGE showed stronger agreement with the annotators on code provenance than on introducing-write labels. On the shared 60-case subset, agreement with each annotator ranged from 85.00% to 88.33% for provenance and from 78.33% to 85.00% for the introducing-write label. Table 6 (c) places this alignment alongside the agreement between annotators, which was higher for provenance (54/60, 90.00%; κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ) than for the introducing-write label (45/60, 75.00%; κ = 0.58 \kappa=0.58 ). This suggests that determining whether a vulnerability was inherited or introduced was more reproducible than identifying its introducing write. Where the annotators reached consensus, SAGE matched their labels in most cases, both for provenance (49/54, 90.74%) and for the introducing-write label (44/45, 97.78%).
paragraphs.zh: 在代码来源问题上，SAGE与标注者的意见一致性高于其在引入写入标签问题上的意见一致性。 在共享的60个案例子集中，每个标注者就代码来源问题的一致性介于85.00%至88.33%之间，而就引入写入标签问题的一致性则介于78.33%至85.00%之间。 表6(c)将这种一致性结果与标注者之间的意见一致性进行了对比：在代码来源问题上，标注者之间的一致性更高（54/60，90.00%；κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78），而引入写入标签问题的一致性则较低（45/60，75.00%；κ = 0.58 \kappa=0.58）。 这表明，判断一个漏洞是继承而来还是新引入的，比识别其引入写入操作更具可重复性。 在标注者达成共识的情况下，SAGE在大多数情形中都匹配了他们的标签，无论是代码来源问题（49/54，90.74%），还是引入写入标签问题（44/45，97.78%）。

paragraphs.en: However, although overall alignment with the human reference remains good, agreement rates varied across task subsets, indicating that aggregate estimates may depend on sample composition. As shown in Table 6 (b), across 1,000 random task-disjoint partitions, we computed subset-level agreement for code provenance (median 84.21%; central 95% of values: 74.42%–96.88%) and for the introducing write (median 81.06%; central 95% of values: 69.39%–93.33%). In the leave-one-task-out analysis, we recomputed agreement after excluding each task in turn, for code provenance (82.56%–89.87%) and for the introducing write (79.07%–87.34%). The highest values for both labels followed the exclusion of the task with the most cases (16 of 95), which accounted for a large share of the disagreements on code provenance (7 of 15) and on the introducing write (8 of 18). Overall, subset-level estimates appear to vary considerably with task composition, whereas no single task appears to inflate the aggregate estimate.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，尽管与人类参考的整体一致性仍然良好，但不同任务子集的一致性率存在差异，这表明汇总估计值可能取决于样本构成。 如表 6(b) 所示，在 1,000 个随机且互不重叠的任务划分中，我们计算了代码来源（中位数 84.21%；中间 95% 的数值范围：74.42%–96.88%）和引入性写入（中位数 81.06%；中间 95% 的数值范围：69.39%–93.33%）的子集级一致性。 在“逐个排除任务”的分析中，我们依次排除每个任务后重新计算了代码来源（82.56%–89.87%）和引入性写入（79.07%–87.34%）的一致性。 两个标签的最高数值均出现在排除案例最多（95 个中的 16 个）的任务之后，该任务在代码来源不一致中占较大比例（15 个中的 7 个），在引入性写入不一致中也占较大比例（18 个中的 8 个）。 总体而言，子集级估计值似乎会因任务构成而有显著差异，而没有任何单一任务会人为抬高汇总估计值。

paragraphs.en: To answer RQ3, we analyse how localization reliability varies with the kind of confirmed deficiency, the agent framework, the base model, and the available artefact history. We compare SAGE with R1 on code provenance and the introducing-write label, and use repeated scoring and independent judges to assess the stability of the reasoning-based origin turn. Figure 6 and Table 7 summarize the observed differences. All subgroup comparisons are descriptive because the confirmed SF subsets differ in task, vulnerability, and trace composition. Estimates are particularly limited for CAMEL ( n = 4 n=4 ), OpenHands ( n = 9 n=9 ), Kimi K3 ( n = 5 n=5 ), and Qwen3.8-Max ( n = 1 n=1 ).

paragraphs.en: SAGE aligned most with human references in absent-defence cases, but this advantage did not improve origin-turn stability. Figure 6 (a) groups the 95 cases according to manual confirmation of the delivered code: an absent defence, an insufficient defence, or a vulnerability introduced by the change. This classification describes the confirmed silent failure and differs from the origin types reported in Section 4.1 . For absent-defence cases, SAGE agreed with R1 on both provenance and the introducing-write label in 93.75% of cases (60/64). Agreement was notably lower for insufficient-defence cases, reaching 61.54% (16/26) for provenance and 53.85% (14/26) for the introducing-write label. This contrast suggests that agreement with R1 on the artefact-derived outputs and origin-turn consistency under repeated scoring capture different properties of the localization.

paragraphs.en: For agent frameworks, differences emerge both in human alignment and in the opportunities available to detect vulnerabilities down the trace. paragraphs.en: Final-code analysis and origin localization answer different questions (RQ1). The final patch shows that a vulnerability is present, and the artefact history adds its code provenance and, where one exists, the introducing write. Neither shows where the repair process first diverged from the task’s security intent. In 73 of the 95 cases (76.84%), the vulnerable code was inherited from the input file (see Table 5 (a)): a diff reports no change at the vulnerable location, so code-level analysis has no position to report. SAGE nevertheless assigned an origin in 72 of these cases from the recorded reasoning (see Figure 4 (a)). In the 19 agent-introduced cases, a diff does identify the introducing write, but in 14 of them (73.68%) the origin was an earlier turn, as an unaddressed requirement (8) or an inadequate defence choice (6) (see Table 5 (c) and Figure 4 ). In these cases, the write marks where the vulnerability entered the file, whereas the divergence was already observable at an earlier turn. Code-level analysis would thus report an introducing write in 19 of the 95 cases, and this write was the assigned origin in only five, all from single-message traces with no earlier turn (see Table 5 (b)).

paragraphs.en: Origin type and exact origin turn should be evaluated separately (RQ2). Agreement on the origin type exceeded agreement on the exact origin turn under repeated scoring (96.49% against 87.72%) and between judges (92.00% against 78.00%) (see Table 6 (a)). The two outputs depend on the scores in different ways. The origin type records which candidate of the rule was selected, whereas the exact turn also depends on the score assigned at each individual turn, so a small score difference at one turn may move the origin while leaving its type unchanged. Figure 5 (b) is consistent with this reading: the dimension scores of the two judges differed by at most one point in 90.00% to 96.00% of the jointly localized cases, yet the judges selected the same turn in 78.00%. A one-turn tolerance recovered only part of the difference, raising agreement to 91.23% and 84.00%, so some disagreements extend beyond neighbouring turns. A single localization score would hide this contrast. We therefore suggest reporting the origin type and the origin turn separately, and the turn both exactly and within one turn. The origin type may remain informative, for example about whether the divergence concerns requirement coverage or defence selection, when the exact turn is uncertain. These estimates should also be read alongside joint localization coverage, since agreement among jointly localized cases does not describe cases left undetermined in one or more assessments.

paragraphs.en: Preserving intermediate artefact states matters for agent framework design (RQ3). Final-only traces had the lowest agreement in all three comparisons (see Figure 6 (b)): 4/7 on the introducing write against R1, and 2/4 and 1/4 on the exact origin turn under repeated scoring and between judges. Per-write traces, which preserve every intermediate state, still had lower agreement than single-write traces in all three comparisons, so part of the difference may reflect the number of writes in a trace and not only missing states. The final-only group is small ( n = 7 n=7 ), but the direction was the same in comparisons that rest on different sources of evidence. For framework design, this suggests recording a snapshot after each write and keeping the boundaries of individual writes, so that reasoning turns can be related to code changes during an audit.

paragraphs.en: Implications for future evaluation of agentic repair systems. Taken together, the results suggest four practices: (i) security evaluation should not stop at the delivered patch, since test passage and final-code checks show whether a repair is insecure, whereas a trace-based analysis adds where the divergence first became observable (see Table 5 and Figure 4 ); (ii) the origin type and the exact origin turn should each be reported with its own consistency estimate (see Table 6 (a)); (iii) consistency and human agreement should both be reported and kept apart, since they cover different outputs (see Tables 6 and 7 ); and (iv) results should be reported by reconstruction condition and by subgroup, with small groups given as counts, since aggregate agreement can hide differences in the available evidence (see Figure 6 and Table 7 ). Later turns suggest a further direction. At least one missed detection opportunity was flagged in 59 of the 95 cases (see Table 5 (d)), as in the sorting-repair case in which the review did not address the remaining unsafe configuration (see Section 4.1 ). This is a pattern observed in our corpus and not a general conclusion about reviewer agents; whether an explicit security requirement check in review turns reduces silent failures, and at what cost, remains to be evaluated in future work. SAGE’s origin assignments can thus inform hypotheses about where to intervene, but whether such interventions prevent silent failures requires controlled intervention studies beyond the present observational analysis.

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. The origin turn is an operational construct: the earliest observable, trace-attributable divergence under the SAGE rule. It does not establish that the selected turn caused the vulnerability or that intervening there would have prevented it, and incomplete records may conceal earlier divergence. A zero score means that no relevant reasoning was recorded, not that the agent had none, and a missed detection opportunity marks a low-scoring later turn, not a turn at which detection would have succeeded. Human annotation covers only the artefact-derived outputs; origin type and turn are assessed through repeated scoring and cross-judge comparison, which measure consistency rather than correctness. paragraphs.en: Internal validity. LLM-judge scoring may introduce run-to-run variation, dependence on the judge model, or hindsight bias. We addressed these risks in five ways: prefix-only scoring; a verbatim quotation for every non-zero score; three scoring runs by the primary judge on a 60-case subset; a second judge from a different model family on the same subset; and comparison of the artefact-derived outputs with two annotators who did not see the SAGE outputs (see Table 6 ). These measures reduce but do not remove the threat: the two judges jointly localized 50 of the 60 cases with 78.00% exact-turn agreement, and biases shared by both judges, inherited from the rubric, or arising from family overlap with the evaluated base models (the primary judge with GPT-5.5 and the second judge with Claude Opus 4.8) cannot be excluded. The annotators used the same reconstructed histories as SAGE, so shared reconstruction errors may inflate agreement, and R1 took part in corpus construction and rule design; we therefore report agreement with R2 separately. As confirmed cases concentrate in few tasks, we assessed sensitivity to task composition with task-disjoint resampling (see Section 4.2 ).

paragraphs.en: External validity. The evaluation covers 95 confirmed silent failures from Python repair tasks in two security-focused benchmarks, six agent frameworks, and six base models, and may not generalize to other languages, task types, or deployment settings. The corpus is bounded by candidate screening: vulnerable patches flagged by neither static analysis nor exploitability-oriented screening do not enter manual review. The confirmed-failure subsets differ in task, vulnerability, and trace composition, so cross-framework and cross-model differences are descriptive and do not estimate framework- or model-level effects. Estimates for groups with fewer than ten cases (see Table 7 ; Figure 6 ), including final-only traces, are particularly uncertain, which also qualifies the artefact-preservation implication in Section 5.1 .

paragraphs.en: This paper presented SAGE, a trace-based method for localizing the origin of a confirmed silent failure in agentic vulnerability repair. The results show that a divergence from the task’s security intent can become observable in the agent’s plans and explanations before the vulnerable code is written, and that for inherited vulnerabilities it can be localized even when no code change marks it. Final-patch checks therefore show that a repair is insecure, but not where the repair process first diverged. The results also show that the origin type is reproduced more consistently than the exact origin turn, and that judge consistency and agreement with human annotators cover different outputs, so both should be reported. Agreement was lowest for traces that kept only the final file, which suggests that agent frameworks should preserve intermediate code states. Future work will extend the analysis to other programming languages and task types, and will examine through controlled studies whether safeguards placed at the identified origins prevent silent failures.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 SAGE，一种基于轨迹的方法，用于定位智能体漏洞修复中已确认的静默故障的来源。 研究结果表明，在编写出存在漏洞的代码之前，智能体的计划和解释中就可能观察到与任务安全意图的偏离；对于继承性漏洞，即使没有代码变更作为标记，也能定位其来源。 因此，最终补丁的检查可以显示修复存在安全问题，但无法确定修复过程最初偏离安全意图的位置。 研究结果还表明，来源类型的重现一致性高于精确来源步骤的重现一致性，且评估者之间的一致性以及与人类标注者的一致性的覆盖范围不同，因此两者都应被报告。 仅保留最终文件的轨迹所表现出的一致性最低，这表明智能体框架应当保留中间代码状态。 未来的工作将把分析扩展到其他编程语言和任务类型，并通过受控研究检验在已识别的来源处设置的防护机制能否防止静默故障的发生。
